basic_info.description: Calling all investors: Corner Gem with Modern Potential! This charming corner house set on a 3,200 sqft lot is awaiting your re-imagination.  Consisting of 2,100 sqft of possibilities. This property offers 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, and a sun-filled attic bonus space, perfect for your own private office while working from home, a gym for working out, and so much more. This property includes a large garage with 2-car parking and a basement with major expansion potential. Enjoy easy access to public transportation, highways, eclectic eateries, parks, and vibrant urban amenities. This tenant-occupied property is an incredible investment opportunity or place to call home in the future.
